# Task 7 Report — PermissionPanel Three-Style Variant

## What was implemented

Modified `src/components/chat/PermissionPanel.tsx` to wrap each `<PermissionMessage>` in a style-aware container using `styleStore.currentStyle()`.

**Three variants:**
- **Claude**: clean wrapper, `role="group"` with `aria-label`, minimal rounding (`--as-radius`)
- **Codex**: bordered card with `border border-[hsl(var(--bc)/0.1)]`, `p-3`, medium radius
- **Grok**: centered dialog card with `bg-[hsl(var(--b2)/0.4)]`, `rounded-2xl`, `p-4`, `text-center`

PermissionMessage props passed through unchanged — no permission logic touched.

**Extracted `permissionMessage` helper** to avoid duplicating the 11-line PermissionMessage JSX across three Match branches.

**Imports added:** `Switch`, `Match` from solid-js; `styleStore` from `~/stores/styleStore`.

## Tests

- `pnpm tsc --noEmit` — only 2 pre-existing errors in `src/api/tauriApi.ts` (missing generated `tauri-bindings`), zero new errors.

## Files changed

- `src/components/chat/PermissionPanel.tsx` (40 insertions, 11 deletions)

## Self-review

- No scope creep — only PermissionPanel.tsx modified
- PermissionMessage logic completely unchanged
- styleStore is correctly imported, `currentStyle()` is called inside a tracking scope
- Switch/Match covers all 3 style values exhaustively for the StyleName union
- CSS tokens reference `--as-radius` with fallback values matching those in `agent-styles.css`
- Colors use DaisyUI theme tokens via `hsl(var(--bc))` and `hsl(var(--b2))` — orthogonal to DaisyUI themes
